The '''Varadan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Its two suns provided a harsh environment for its most notable world, the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] mining planet of [[Varadan]].
